SOCIAL_GATEWAY_AUTHTOKEN: Require feeders to send this secret in an X-Social-Token header. Leave empty to accept any local connection, which is safe while the server only listens on this machine. Set it before allowing connections from other devices.
SOCIAL_GATEWAY_SERVERPORT: The port to point your feeder at, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3003/social/event. Taken from this scene's remote control server; 0 means it has not started yet.
SOCIAL_GATEWAY_EVENTSRECEIVED: Events accepted since the app started. Use it to confirm a feeder is actually reaching this app.
SOCIAL_GATEWAY_EVENTSDROPPED: Events discarded because they arrived faster than they could be handled. A number climbing here means a feeder is flooding.
SOCIAL_INPUT_SOURCE: Only accept events from this platform, e.g. youtube. Leave empty for any platform.
SOCIAL_INPUT_EVENTTYPE: Only accept this kind of event, e.g. chat or superchat. Leave empty for any kind.
SOCIAL_INPUT_KEYWORD: Only fire when the message contains this text, e.g. !confetti. Case insensitive, and matched anywhere in the message. Leave empty to ignore the message.
SOCIAL_INPUT_USERFILTER: Restrict who can fire this. Members Only accepts members and subscribers, and also moderators and you. Moderators Only accepts moderators and you.
SOCIAL_INPUT_MINAMOUNT: Only fire when the tip or gift is at least this much. 0 accepts any amount.
SOCIAL_INPUT_COOLDOWNSECONDS: Ignore further matches for this many seconds after firing. 0 disables the cooldown.
SOCIAL_INPUT_VALUEFROMAMOUNT: Use the tip amount as the value and hold it until the next event, instead of firing a single pulse. For slider tiles. Leave off for button and toggle tiles, which would stay stuck on.
SOCIAL_INPUT_AMOUNTRANGE: The amount that counts as full strength. Minimum Amount maps to 0 and this maps to 1; anything higher is clamped.
